author: BruhItsBlobby
body:
On July 31st 2015 my friend was banned from avicus from evading a ban because my account was banned and i need him to go on and ask them how to post a ban appeal and they banned him for evading a ban he didnt do anything he just conversed with one of the mods and then the mod was about to tell him when another mod came on and just banned him The mod he was talking to was TheMasterClock thats his IGN and the IGN of the mod who banned him was _Cyanide! So my account was banned on December 24th Christmas Eve 2014 for Harassment and I didnt even do anything and ive been banned ever since, and it wwas the worst christmas eve ever! When I got banned on Christmas Eve I was crying because Avicus is one of my most loved servers by me and I wanted banned so badly but I couldnt do anything,
so could you unban/pardon my friend his IGN is Jerlwein and MY IGN is craftinghunter, please reply I want unbanned/pardoned from avicus. Thank You so much if you have read this :)!
